body_text:
A sequence in a set $X$ is a function $a:\mathbb{N}\to X$. The
index $n$ records position, not value: equal terms may occur at
different indices. A finite sequence of length $m$ is instead a
function on $\{0,\ldots,m-1\}$, so its length is part of its
data.
